remarks: Nestled on a quiet street in the sought-after Newfield/Pepper Ridge area, this lovely property offers an inviting opportunity to create your dream home. Sitting on just under 1/2 acre, the home boasts a serene setting with plenty of space both inside and out. The house has been very well-maintained and features ample living areas, perfect for comfortable living and entertaining. A large addition off the back of the house enhances the layout, adding a spacious dining area, a generously sized family room with a vaulted ceiling, and a convenient powder room. The family room includes a cozy free-standing fireplace, making it an ideal spot to relax during cooler evenings. The upper level of the home includes three bedrooms and two baths, providing privacy and comfort for family or guests. The lower level features an additional bedroom/playroom/office and bathroom, offering flexible living arrangements to suit your needs. This home is full of potential and ready for you to make it your own. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy a peaceful lifestyle in one of Pepper Ridge's most desirable locations!
